description: Collect Wayback Machine capture history, closest snapshots, or archived page text for one URL or a bulk list.

collapseBy.description: Deduplicate adjacent captures in 'search' mode. 'digest' keeps one record per distinct content fingerprint; 'urlkey' keeps one capture per URL; 'monthly', 'daily', and 'hourly' keep one capture per time bucket; 'none' returns every raw capture. 'timeline' and 'summary' always read raw captures so their counts and durations stay accurate.
collapseBy.title: Collapse duplicates

dateFrom.description: Earliest capture date, inclusive. Accepts YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, or a full timestamp such as 2024-01-31T12:00:00.
dateFrom.sectionDescription: These filters are applied by the Wayback CDX API before records are returned.
dateFrom.title: From date

dateTo.description: Latest capture date, inclusive. Uses the same formats as From date. A date without a time includes the whole day.
dateTo.title: To date

detectChanges.description: In 'search' mode, compare each capture with the previous capture of the same URL and add changed, changeType, previousTimestamp, and related fields.
detectChanges.title: Annotate content changes

enrichWithContent.description: In 'search' mode, fetch the archived HTML for the first Max content fetches rows and add its readable text and metadata. Off by default because it costs extra requests.
enrichWithContent.title: Add archived text to search rows

excludeMimeTypes.description: Drop captures with these MIME types, e.g. ['image/png','video/mp4']. Leave empty to exclude nothing.
excludeMimeTypes.title: Exclude MIME types

excludeStatusCodes.description: Drop captures with these HTTP status codes, e.g. ['404','500']. Leave empty to exclude nothing.
excludeStatusCodes.title: Exclude HTTP status codes

includeHeadings.description: Add the page's H1-H6 headings as structured records when archived text is extracted.
includeHeadings.title: Include headings

matchType.description: How the target is matched against the archive. 'exact' = that URL only; 'prefix' = the URL and every path beneath it; 'host' = every path on the same host; 'domain' = the host and all subdomains.
matchType.title: URL match type

maxContentChars.description: Truncate extracted text at this many characters. The full word count and text hash are still recorded, and contentTruncated is set when clipping happens.
maxContentChars.title: Max characters per archived page

maxContentFetch.description: Cap on archived pages downloaded when 'Add archived text to search rows' is on. 0 disables enrichment. This setting is ignored by 'content' mode, which uses Max items instead.
maxContentFetch.title: Max text fetches for search rows

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. For bulk search the budget is split evenly across targets. In 'summary' mode it is also the per-target capture scan budget, split between the oldest and newest ends. Up to 100,000 captures are supported through automatic resume-key pagination.
maxItems.sectionDescription: Control row volume and change annotations.
maxItems.title: Max items

mimeTypes.description: Only keep captures with these MIME types, e.g. ['text/html','application/pdf']. Leave empty for all MIME types.
mimeTypes.title: Keep MIME types

mode.description: What to collect. 'search' returns every matching capture; 'timeline' returns one row per distinct content version; 'summary' returns archive coverage per target; 'closest' returns the nearest capture to a date; 'content' returns readable text from the archived page.
mode.sectionDescription: Pick the result shape first, then set the target and filters below.
mode.title: Mode

sortDirection.description: Choose whether the limited result set comes from the oldest or newest captures. Search rows are emitted in chronological order; 'latest' reverses the final rows so the newest appears first.
sortDirection.title: Which end of the archive

statusCodes.description: Only keep captures with these HTTP status codes, e.g. ['200','301']. Leave empty for all statuses. Values may also be comma-separated.
statusCodes.title: Keep HTTP status codes

targetDate.description: Date used by 'closest' and 'content' modes, and as the reference when a playback URL does not include a timestamp. Accepts YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, or a full timestamp. Defaults to now when empty.
targetDate.sectionDescription: These settings control date matching and text extraction.
targetDate.title: Target date

url.description: One URL, host, domain, or Wayback playback URL. Examples: 'apify.com', 'https://example.com/blog', 'https://web.archive.org/web/20240101000000/https://apify.com/'. Wildcards like 'example.com/*' and '*.example.com' are detected automatically.
url.sectionDescription: Use the single field or the bulk list; both are merged and deduplicated.
url.title: URL or domain (single target)

urls.description: One or more targets for batch collection. Each target is queried independently and the Max items budget is split across them.
urls.title: URLs or domains (bulk)

title: Wayback Machine Snapshot History & Archived Text Input
